correctness.rationale: The Legendre identities are exact, the upper bound uses the elementary fact that positive 3n cannot have binary weight one, and Kummer carries prove nonattainment of valuation one by a forced adjacent second carry. Explicit even/odd seeds have the claimed binary weights and multiplying by 3 leaves exactly two or three ones; padding \(n\mapsto4n+1\) raises A but preserves B. Shifts by powers of two give infinitely many distinct realizations. Verification checked 2400 exact integer valuation identities, 1200 carry comparisons, all \(n<2^{17}\), and 3541 witness pairs for \(k\le60\). Computation is corroboration; the proof covers all k.

value.rationale: The exact simultaneous divisibility support of the central and \(\binom{3n}{n}\) binomial families is a natural joint arithmetic invariant. It identifies a universal internal gap, a sharp fiber maximum and explicit infinite realizations of every other allowed value, which neither a marginal valuation sequence nor an asymptotic joint normal law supplies. The exact infinite family of fibers has direct structural motivation from two canonical binomial coefficient families; it is not an arbitrary bounded parameter slice.
